card.name: Endings of long drug and medical terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long, multi-part drug or medical term, such as the ending of fondaparinux, alafenamide or armodafinil. It also fires on endings of rare adjectives like scarlatiniform.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Final piece of a generic drug name, often right before sodium or a drug abbreviation.

modes.label: Medical term endings
modes.description: Closing piece of a long anatomical or clinical adjective.
modes.example: morbilliform and scarlatin<<iform>> reactions, urticaria and eryth
